_meta.purpose: Trigger and no-trigger contract for the Taskbean skill shipped in the v0.7 Copilot plugin. skill.test.mjs checks the contract deterministically and replays each expected command sequence against an isolated Taskbean store. Model trigger rates are measured separately with the opt-in live run described in README.md.

placeholders.<title>: An outcome-oriented task title chosen by the agent.
placeholders.<id>: The id returned by the preceding bean add --json call.
